import numpy as np

def shannon_entropy(probabilities):
    p = probabilities[probabilities > 0]
    entropy = -np.sum(p * np.log2(p))
    return entropy

def joint_entropy(joint_probs):
    p = joint_probs.flatten()
    p = p[p > 0]
    return -np.sum(p * np.log2(p))

def conditional_entropy(joint_probs):
    p_x = joint_probs.sum(axis=1)
    p_x = p_x[p_x > 0]
    h_x = -np.sum(p_x * np.log2(p_x))
    h_xy = joint_entropy(joint_probs)
    return h_xy - h_x

fair_coin = np.array([0.5, 0.5])
print(f"Fair coin entropy: {shannon_entropy(fair_coin)} bits")

biased_coin = np.array([0.9, 0.1])
print(f"Biased coin entropy: {shannon_entropy(biased_coin):.4f} bits")
